item.title: Backing Up a Kubernetes Cluster with Velero
item.description: 1. Introduction to Velero Velero is an open-source Kubernetes cluster backup and migration tool from the heptio team (acquired by VMWare). Velero stores cluster resources in object storage. It supports AWS, Azure, and GCP object storage by default, is compatible with the S3 protocol, and can be extended to other platforms such as Aliyun OSS through plugins.
